nodes.title: Adopter-project features: upgrade, agent-file layering, planning hygiene, project tooling (after 0.3.1)

acceptance: A project chooses its analysis set in checks: either specy-road's built-in set (the ruff rule families and shrink-only baselines from M16.8) or its own entries naming tools such as mypy, radon, pylint or eslint; validate names the active set and warns about a declared tool that is not installed
Declared tools run through the existing checks: machinery (when:, zones:, per-commit merge-blocking results from M16.52) with no tool-specific code path beyond a small table of known tools

An agent-facing command or shipped prompt detects which known analysis tools are already installed in the project's environment and prints a proposed checks: block that gives parity with the built-in set at the same points (baseline, ready, land); it never installs anything and never writes the config itself
Tests cover the built-in set alone, a declared custom tool, a declared tool that is missing, and the proposal for a repo with mypy and radon installed and for one with none
nodes.title: Configurable code-analysis tools

acceptance: specy-road validate prints nothing about the research register: the cadence check (warn_research_register and its helpers) no longer runs from validate_roadmap.py

specy-road doctor prints one line per register entry that is past its cadence, has never run, has a missing or out-of-tree prompt, or has an unreadable cadence_days or last_run, with the same wording as today's validate warning, and nothing when every entry is current
The research README template, this repo's research/README.md and docs/roadmap-authoring.md and docs/install-and-usage.md say doctor reports due research, not validate
Tests: validate's output contains no research line for an overdue entry; doctor prints exactly one line per overdue entry and none for a current one
nodes.title: Research reminders leave validate

acceptance: work/prompt-<NODE_ID>.md written by do-next-available-task (and by grind-session's pickup) has exactly one `base: <full sha>` line in its execution-target section: the commit the leaf branch was created from, or for a resumed branch its merge base with the integration branch

The shared-checkout clause in specy_road/templates/specyrd/agents-rules.md says prompts written by do-next-available-task and specy-road prompt carry `base:`, and keeps 'ask' only for a plan or prompt from elsewhere that names none; its provenance comment says the same
Tests: a fresh claim's prompt and a resumed claim's prompt each carry the expected sha; the template test pins the new clause text
nodes.title: The pickup prompt names its base commit

acceptance: The 'Task pickup' bullet in specy_road/templates/specyrd/agents-rules.md no longer names `--local`: it says pickup pushes the claim and not to skip that step; its provenance comment no longer calls --local 'the only opt-out'
`do-next-available-task --help` and docs/dev-workflow.md still document --local, and its behaviour is unchanged
Tests: the rendered managed block contains no `--local`, and the pickup --help still lists it
nodes.title: The managed block stops naming pickup's --local opt-out

acceptance: The managed block template (specy_road/templates/specyrd/agents-rules.md) gains a 'Recording human decisions' rule: when the human makes a decision, names an open item (options, recommendation, needed-by) or states a standing rule in chat, the agent records it at once with specy-road decisions add (kind decision, human-action or preference) instead of prose, and searches the ledger before asking; a test pins the rule text

The coordinator prompt's ledger section and specyrd-orchestrate.md each gain one line saying to run decisions add whenever the human decides something unprompted, not only when answering an open question; tests pin both lines

digest writes an 'Open human decisions' section to roadmap-context.md listing open decision and human-action entries from the tracked roadmap/decisions.yaml only (never decisions.local.yaml), in needed-by order, each with id, node, summary and needed-by; at most 10 entries then one '+N more: specy-road decisions list' line; no section when none are open; digest --check passes twice in a row on a fixture

review status <ID> ends with the open decision and human-action entries whose node is that leaf or one of its ancestors, with needed-by; it prints nothing extra when there are none and its exit codes are unchanged

decisions add --help marks each flag the schema requires for a kind (for --kind decision: --recommendation, --recommendation-reason, --default and the others the schema's kind conditional lists) as required for that kind, and an add missing them fails with one message naming every missing flag; tests cover the help text and the error
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +70, templates and docs about +15
nodes.title: Human decisions get recorded and shown: agent rule, digest, review status and decisions add --help

acceptance: decisions.schema.json (bundled and sr/schemas copy) allows an optional top-level id_prefix (starts with a letter, same characters as id); new entries of every kind get <id_prefix><n>, or DEC-<n> when id_prefix is unset, where n is one past the highest trailing number on any id in the tracked and local ledgers; --id still overrides
Existing ids are never rewritten: on a fixture ledger with D1 to D4 and P1, decisions list leaves the file byte-identical, close and --supersedes accept the old ids, and decisions add writes DEC-5

decisions add prints one warning (the write still happens, exit 0) when the new id appears as a whole word in constitution/, constraints/, the root AGENTS.md or planning/*.md, naming up to 5 file:line hits and suggesting --id or id_prefix; no warning when it appears nowhere

docs/orchestration.md's ledger section and decisions add --help describe id_prefix and the DEC- default; tests cover the default, a configured prefix, the mixed old ledger, and the warning with and without a hit
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +50
nodes.title: Decision ids take a project prefix (default DEC-) and warn when a new id already appears in governance files

acceptance: When a leaf's planning sheet has a '## Acceptance criteria' section, validate prints one notice if its items differ from the node's acceptance after normalising (list markers, checkboxes, backticks, case, whitespace and trailing punctuation removed), listing the lines only in the node and the lines only in the sheet; no notice when they match or the section is absent; validate's exit code is unchanged

For each type: gate node, validate prints one notice per own dependency whose display id or codename appears as a whole word in neither the gate's acceptance nor its sheet, naming the gate, the dependency and the sheet's '## Criteria to clear' section

add-dependency on a gate node prints one reminder line after a successful write naming the gate, the new dependency and the two places to name it; a non-gate target prints no line; roadmap_crud_dependency_ops.py gains only a call line

No edit-node --sync-sheet is added (the sheet records why); docs/roadmap-authoring.md documents both notices; tests cover a matching sheet, a drifted sheet with a line moved from node to sheet, a sheet without the section, gate dependencies named in acceptance, in the sheet and in neither, and add-dependency on a gate and a non-gate
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +90
nodes.title: validate notices sheet acceptance that drifted from the node, and gate dependencies the gate never names

acceptance: validate_self_heal's deprecated list becomes a table pairing each stripped field with a one-line replacement (agentic_checklist and agentic_checklist.contract_citation: cite contracts in the planning sheet's ## References; execution_subtask: the Execution type tagging table in docs/roadmap-authoring.md); which fields are stripped is unchanged

validate prints one notice per hit when a file under constitution/ or constraints/, or the root AGENTS.md outside its managed specy-road block, names a field from that table as a whole word (dotted form included): '<file>:<line> names <field>, which validate strips from roadmap chunks; use <replacement>'; no file is edited and the exit code is unchanged

Tests: a principles.md requiring agentic_checklist.contract_citation gives one notice with the replacement; a constraints file naming execution_subtask gives one; the field inside the managed block, clean files and the dogfood fixture give none; docs/roadmap-authoring.md says validate reports such governance text
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +45
nodes.title: validate notices governance files that require a field validate strips, and names the replacement

acceptance: decisions.schema.json (bundled and sr/schemas copy) adds kind scope, which requires node (the last ratified phase or milestone) and forbids the decision-only and preference-only fields; decisions add --kind scope <NODE> --summary records it, --supersedes closes the earlier scope entry in the same write, and the newest open scope entry is the boundary

validate prints one notice listing the nodes beyond the boundary (the later siblings, in outline order, of the boundary node and of each of its ancestors, without their descendants), naming the scope entry id and saying to record a new scope entry to extend it; none without a scope entry or when nothing lies beyond; a boundary naming a missing node is a warning; validate's exit code is unchanged

digest adds one line to M19.14's open-decisions section: 'Scope ratified through <node> (<entry id>); beyond it: <ids>'; no line without a scope entry; digest --check passes twice in a row on a fixture

The 'Recording human decisions' rule gains one sentence on recording a scope ratification with --kind scope, and docs/orchestration.md documents the kind; tests cover schema accept and reject, a boundary at a phase and at a milestone, no entry, a superseded boundary and a missing node
Estimated net line change (informational, not a gate): package about +90
nodes.title: A ratified scope boundary in the decisions ledger, with validate and digest notices for phases beyond it
